annotator: authored from the fixture's planted values, independently of the detectors
notes: The customer ID in input#customer-id (MB4470193) is deliberately NOT annotated. It is identifying, but no type in the PRD §4.3 taxonomy covers a service-specific account identifier, and inventing one would change the taxonomy the corpus and demo script assume. It is therefore neither a true positive nor a false negative here — it is out of scope, and named as such rather than quietly omitted.
